correctness.rationale: On smooth genus-three C: X^4+Y^4+Z^4=0 over F5, independently counted N1=0,N2=44,N3=192 with exact finite field arithmetic (including points at infinity), yielding Weil L(T)=(1−2T+5T²)^3 and |J(F5)|=64. The 16 ordinary rational bitangents X+aY+bZ=0 (a,b nonzero F5) together with 12 hyperflex lines over F25 exhaust 28 odd theta; Frobenius on odd theta has 16 fixed and 6 two-cycles. Theta quadratic-refinement polarization forces rational 2-torsion fixed dimension five: dimension four would be an impossible totally isotropic 4-space in symplectic F2^6; dimension six would fix all 28. Consequently J(F5) ≅ Z/4⊕(Z/2)^4, with 16 rational even theta. Since C(F5)=0, there are 44/2=22 rational effective degree-two Frobenius-pair divisors and distinct linear classes (nonhyperelliptic). Pic^2(F5) has 64 via rational theta, leaving 42 non-effective classes, equivalent to ordinary 4×4 LDR classes. Exactly 16 non-effective rational even theta yield symmetric classes, remaining 26 nonsymmetric; classifications are up to left/right and projective congruence, respectively. The cited classical line-bundle/determinantal correspondence is required, not proven merely by the code.
